results.title: Command/Control, =/Shift+plus, minus and reset work in the search input without inserting shortcut characters or resizing the window
150% layout keeps selection and navigation, and scaled result/path hit targets select and copy the correct file
Zoom works during inline rename without committing, cancelling or editing the filename
Tree-focused zoom preserves the viewed rows and selection; titlebar resizing uses the scaled sidebar width
Repeated shortcuts stop at 50% and 200%; the 400x300 window stays usable and reset restores the layout
Zoom and sidebar/column proportions survive restart and theme changes; shortcuts also work with the settings popover open
